notes:
Has two related uses: for Western playing cards, it refers to the face cards (jack, queen, king); for traditional Japanese card games, it refers to the illustrated cards used in games like ⟦{花札|はなふだ}→花札：22650_hanafuda⟧, ⟦かるた→かるた：21979_karuta⟧, and ⟦{百人一首|ひゃくにんいっしゅ}→百人一首：22329_hyakuninisshu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦トランプ→トランプ：03864_toranpu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{絵札|えふだ}: playing card face cards
- ⟦かるた→かるた：21979_karuta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{絵札|えふだ}: karuta picture cards
- ⟦{花札|はなふだ}→花札：22650_hanafuda⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{絵札|えふだ}: hanafuda picture cards
- {絵札|えふだ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to grab a picture card (in karuta)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {数札|かずふだ}: number cards — the cards without pictures (ace through 10 in Western cards)
- {読|よ}み{札|ふだ}: reading card — in karuta, the card that is read aloud (paired with the picture card)
- {取|と}り{札|ふだ}: grabbing card — in karuta, the card players grab from the floor
